name: Striker
summary: Damage dealer. Hits hardest and finishes fights: the warrior, the duelist, the blaster.

steps.text: +1 to all Attack rolls when Stamina is in Healthy range (boxes 1–5).
Battle-Hardened: When you roll a Natural 1 on an attack, the GM doesn’t pick from the Bane Menu. You take only the −2.
Once per encounter, reroll a Technique attack after paying its cost. Take the second result.
Relentless: Once per round, add 2 free Effort boxes to one attack. This counts as Effort 2 for your Signature Effect.
Unstoppable: Once per round, after you hit, make one Basic Attack at no Action cost.

design_note: Striker gets stronger when fresh. The Basher Specialty and the Battle Fury Feat lean the other way, toward fighting hurt.

name: Defender
summary: Shield for the group. Absorbs damage and controls who gets targeted.

steps.text: +1 DR (stacks with armor). Interpose costs 0 Reactions once per round.
Broken threshold +1 — Stamina pool holds until box 16 before Broken.
Successful Interpose grants the protected ally Braced until end of round.
DR bonus increases to +2. Passive, always on.
Once per encounter, completely absorb one hit targeting any ally in Close range. No damage to either character.

design_note: Defender is outward-facing — protects others. Survivor is inward-facing — cannot be stopped. Both are defensive identities but mechanically and narratively distinct.

name: Leader
summary: Holds the group together: heals, helps and rallies. The medic, the cleric, the captain.

steps.text: Rally: Once per round, a committed assist (+4) costs you no Action. When you heal or Tend, unmark 1 extra box.
Once per scene, clear one ongoing Condition (Bleeding, Burning, Poisoned, Stunned, or Weakened 1 level) from any ally as a free action — no roll, no pool cost.
A successful out-of-combat Tend (one uninterrupted Task Block) clears the Injured condition (boxes 11–14), which normally needs magical healing.
Lead on an ally in Close range costs no Action once per round, and allies in Near range get +1 to Defend while you can act.
Once per session, bring an ally at any Stamina state, even Broken, back into the fight. No roll. They can act this round but are Weakened until a Full Rest, and their Hurt boxes (6–10) clear.

design_note: Leader keeps others going. It works with or without magic: a field medic, a priest and a ship’s captain are all Leaders.

name: Controller
summary: Shapes the battlefield: areas, Conditions and position. The battle mage, the trapper, the tactician.

steps.text: Shaped Technique: Once per scene, add one upgrade to a Technique without raising its cost. Its Rank still rises and can’t pass your highest Rank.
Conditions you apply with a Technique last until the end of the target’s next turn after they would end.
Effort on area Techniques (Several or Everyone) costs 1 box less, minimum 1.
Once per scene, use one Rank 1 or Rank 2 Technique for free — no boxes, no Effort cost.
Once per session, use any Technique for free. Effort is still paid if you use it.

design_note: Controller was the Caster: now any Technique counts, so a trapper or a tactician fits as well as a wizard.

name: Infiltrator
summary: Goes where others can’t: stealth, scouting, locks and traps. The thief, the scout, the burglar.

steps.text: Disengage free once per round. +2 to Observe, Stealth and Legerdemain rolls outside combat.
First attack each encounter from Hidden bypasses Defend — the target may only Deflect.
Once per scene, move up to 2 range bands as a free action, or open a lock or trap of Standard quality or below with no roll.
Once per scene, apply Hidden to yourself as a free action.
Your first attack each round is always treated as coming from Hidden — the target may only Deflect. Passive, no declaration needed.

design_note: Infiltrator was the Scout, widened to thieves and burglars. The spy is a Face with the Chameleon Specialty.

name: Face
summary: Talks for the group: persuades, deceives and reads people. The diplomat, the con artist, the negotiator.
prerequisite_text: No prerequisite. Typically pairs with high Morale and social Focus Skills.

steps.text: +2 to all social skill rolls when Reputation applies.
Once per scene, take a second social action (Press or Hold) without spending an Action.
Once per session, reroll any failed social skill roll after seeing the result.
The +2 bonus now applies to all social skill rolls unconditionally — not only when Reputation applies.
Reputation applies even when you are unknown: the +2 bonus fires on all social rolls regardless of context.

design_note: Face was the Speaker. Its free Lead action moved to the Leader.

name: Expert
summary: Problem solving through knowledge. Builds, deduces and adapts: the group's answer to problems no specialist can solve.

steps.text: +2 to Analyze and Observe when examining a scene, object or person. Given tools and one uninterrupted Task Block, repair any damaged item without a roll.
Once per scene, use any non-Focus Skill as a Focus Skill for one roll. Modify an item to grant a specific +1 bonus (GM approved) until it is used in combat; one active modification at a time.

Once per session, choose one: name a conclusion about a scene or person, and the GM says whether you are right (if wrong, one true thing that points to the answer); or create a single-use item that replicates a non-magical Skill effect.
Between sessions, make one modification permanent. Staged evidence, environmental misdirection and mundane forgeries do not fool you.

Once per session, choose one: reconstruct a past event you have evidence of in full; create an item one step beyond the Genre's technology ceiling; or name a Skill, and its Ability Score counts as 2 higher for the scene.

design_note: Expert replaces Artificer, Investigator and Polymath. The Archetypes show how to lean toward one of them.
